summary: Nearest-neighbor construction builds a complete TSP order by repeatedly appending the closest unused vertex.
description: The input is a finite complete distance matrix and an optional start index. The result lists each vertex once and leaves the return edge implicit. Empty input returns an empty order.

Choose the lightest outgoing arc from the current endpoint to an unused vertex and use the index for ties. This costs quadratic time. The cycle-length helper uses exact integer sums and a stable sum for floating-point distances.
